_units: art pixels (screen = 960x540 art px, 1 art px = 2x2 screen px at 1080p), seconds, degrees. Enemies wake when within screen + 64 px.

player._bullets: cannon fires while held; no new shot while 5 of this player's bullets are on screen

bomb._rule: small torpedo on a ballistic ARC. At release: find the landing point where a line at theta from vertical (from the release point) meets the ground (allow for scroll during the fall); fall time T = sqrt(2H/g) for that drop height H; horizontal speed vx = dx/T, constant; vertical starts at 0 with gravity. 0.8 s from the top of the flight area to normal ground; nearer ground = shorter fall.
bomb.pitch_frames: torpedo sheet, 0..120 deg in 10 deg steps. pitch = target*smoothstep(t/T) + wobble_pitch_deg*sin(...); target 60 (nose 60 deg down, forward) or 120 when the bomb moves backward
bomb._jitter: per bomb, pick theta +- jitter_angle and gravity * (1 +- jitter_gravity) at release, so arcs are never exact
bomb._wobble: w = wobble_px*sin(2pi*wobble_hz*t + random phase), faded in over 0.15 s; x += 0.6w, y += 0.25w

laser._rule: pickup; replaces bullets; beam while fire held, instant hit on the first target or terrain straight ahead
laser.lasts: until the player loses a life

flight.back_limit: left screen edge, never leaves the screen
flight._speed: prototype guess (not in brief yet): full speed the moment a key is pressed

cannon.aim: along ship tilt: -7 deg (down) moving forward, +7 deg (up) moving back, level hovering

enemy_shots._rule: dodgeable but not slow: about 0.4 s from firing to leaving the screen; aimed at the player's CURRENT position (no lead), so moving dodges

whirler_swarm.unfurl_when: x < 0.65*screen or within 300 of a player
whirler_swarm.hits: each segment must be shot separately (1 hit per segment)

fighter.exit: pull up or down past the player and leave left

balloon.blast_kills: anything touching the explosion: enemies, balloons (chains), shots, players without shield

tank.logic: find the spot on its drivable stretch (ground <= 25 deg) where barrel elevation + ground angle points at the player; drive there; fire when within aim_tolerance

rocket_truck.logic: same as tank, one launcher angle

ground_vehicles.wheeled: flat or very smooth ground only (runways, roads, metal decks, '_' flats)

thunder.lightning_cost: a hit removes the laser and empties the shield; never costs a life

clouds.hide: ships and enemies inside a cloud are drawn under it

self_visibility_options.outline: 1 px outline in player colour at ~60% alpha

radar.dot: red 5x5 art px with ring, blinks 4 Hz
radar.lasts: until that player loses a life (proposed)
radar.shared_screen: dots show while either player has radar (proposed)

landing.input: at ground level over a runway, fly backward + hold down
landing.takeoff: straight up, 90 art px/s, gear retracts after 0.2 s

enemy_airfield.note: hostile airport: red markings, no helipad, no radar box; can't land (Glen confirmed)
enemy_airfield.attack: burst of 3 aimed bullets (0.1 s apart) at 300..640 px range, then pull up past the player and leave left

ram_cost._note: enemy that hits the shield blows up; all values Glen confirmed; a ram is absorbed even if it empties the shield

title._note: logo: chrome (style A) or sunset (style C)

music._note: p2_lead: flute or harp. level2_song: file name in assets/music (no .xm)
